prompt_fragment:
This asset is UI chrome or ornamentation. Keep it decorative, controlled, and cleanly cuttable from the background.
Keep decorative edges controlled and production-friendly for UI extraction.
raw_description:
A centered compass rose in the style of an antique nautical chart —
eight-pointed star with elongated N-S axis, fleur-de-lis at north,
finely inked concentric degree rings.
formatted_prompt: Ink and watercolor on aged vellum parchment, centered square composition with generous negative space for clean extraction. A single antique nautical compass rose, eight-pointed star form with elongated north-south axis, fleur-de-lis finial at north point, fine nib-pen linework rendering concentric degree rings and cardinal tick marks. Warm vellum ground (#E7E3D5) beneath the rose, star points rendered in slate and warm sand tones with ember-gold (#D97742) accent on the north fleur-de-lis. Subtle foxing at parchment edges, faint ink bleed at fine line junctions, muted archival saturation throughout. Controlled decorative boundary, no loose painterly spatter outside the rose form, soft ink shadow grounding the central device. Museum-plate register, 19th-century expedition chart aesthetic.
